categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Block storage' maintainer label and modifies block index / blockstorage metadata validation on initialization.
categories.rationale: Prevents startup crashes and undefined behavior when reading corrupted block index records. As described, an invalid last file number or corrupted parent link previously triggered out-of-bounds vector reads or assertion failures, whereas this patch makes the node fail cleanly and request a reindex.
